selection: Illustrative manually reviewed sample, not an exhaustive event inventory

events.title: Ondas acquisitions and share registration
events.source_fact: Ondas announced three defense-technology acquisitions. Its 8-K distinguishes acquisition-issued shares from registration for their resale.
events.analytical_inference: Include the new consideration, contingent obligations and shares in the next cash/dilution bridge; separate acquired from organic activity.
events.limitation: The complete quarterly liquidity and share bridges remain untested. A resale registration must not be counted as a second issuance.

events.title: SoFi stablecoin settlement launch
events.source_fact: SoFi and Mastercard announced live stablecoin settlement and plans to migrate SoFi card settlement.
events.analytical_inference: Track evidence of commercial adoption and revenue contribution in subsequent disclosures.
events.limitation: Transaction volume is not revenue. This issuer claim does not establish the quarterly growth or Technology Platform result.

events.title: Fed proposed stablecoin framework
events.source_fact: The Federal Reserve requested comment on two proposals for Board-supervised payment stablecoin issuers.
events.analytical_inference: Track sector policy and separately verify the relevant supervisor and legal entity before assigning a direct company effect.
events.limitation: Proposals are not final rules. The release does not establish direct applicability to SoFi or Robinhood; SoFi Bank has a different primary supervisor.

new_issue_candidates.topic: Stablecoin supervision and economics; verify applicable jurisdiction before adding a company question.

events.title: New Era announces Vistra power agreement
events.source_fact: New Era Energy & Digital announced a 20-year power agreement with Luminant, a Vistra subsidiary, with supply expected in Q3 2027.
events.analytical_inference: Follow execution and contract economics as additional context for Vistra power demand.
events.limitation: Counterparty announcement. Future supply is not current revenue; it does not answer the saved Meta/AWS delivery milestones.

sources.publisher: New Era Energy & Digital via GlobeNewswire

events.title: Vistra completes subordinated debt offering
events.source_fact: Vistra disclosed completion of $1.5 billion of junior subordinated notes in two series on September 24.
events.analytical_inference: Add the financing to the next debt/cash reconciliation and check its use and cost.
events.limitation: The filing alone does not establish the complete financing criterion, acquisition funding or maturity coverage.

events.title: INRY ServiceNow deployment case study
events.event_date_or_timing: Purchase March 2026; implementation six weeks later; exact date unspecified
events.source_fact: INRY published a ServiceNow EmployeeWorks deployment case study, describing a March purchase and subsequent six-week implementation.
events.analytical_inference: Useful qualitative adoption context; seek broader disclosure for subscription growth and contracted demand.
events.limitation: Partner-reported benefits, not independently measured. Publication this week does not make the implementation a new September sale.

events.title: Amazon registration refers to earlier financing
events.event_date_or_timing: Related financing closed 2026-09-14, outside pilot window
events.source_fact: Amazon filed an 8-A debt registration referring to a September 9 prospectus and September 14 financing closing.
events.analytical_inference: Link this document to the earlier financing event to avoid counting new funding twice.
events.limitation: The September 24 filing date is not proof of new cash raised that day.

sources.locator: description of securities and incorporated prospectus

events.title: Kuehne+Nagel announces Amazon collaboration
events.source_fact: Kuehne+Nagel announced an expanded long-term Amazon collaboration including logistics through the AWS infrastructure lifecycle.
events.analytical_inference: Monitor infrastructure delivery and supply-chain capacity as context for AWS growth.
events.limitation: Counterparty announcement does not quantify Amazon revenue, cash returns or the outcome of the saved quarterly criterion.

events.title: Google discusses planned orbital AI test
events.source_fact: Google described a planned prototype satellite test for Project Suncatcher, a long-term research project.
events.analytical_inference: Track as an emerging research topic; seek cost and commercial evidence before changing investment assumptions.
events.limitation: The publication describes a planned test, not a completed launch or an established revenue stream. No implication for ASTS is established.

sources.locator: planned first orbital test and research limitations

new_issue_candidates.topic: Orbital AI research; monitor only if material costs or commercial commitments emerge.

events.title: AppLovin legal notice needs primary verification
events.source_fact: A plaintiff law firm published a notice stating that a securities lawsuit had been filed.
events.analytical_inference: Retrieve the complaint and court status before linking any substantiated issue to platform access or business assumptions.
events.limitation: The court complaint was not reviewed. A law-firm advertisement is not a finding of misconduct; repeated notices should be deduplicated.
